acceptance: Each of the eight findings has a fix and a failing-before test, or a recorded reason it does not apply after the owner's decisions.
The independent reviewer, not the implementer, resolved the review threads.
context: Filed 2026-11-20 from the adversarial review of the scale-factor and TPC-DI remediation work (PRs #4298-#4385 and benchbox-site #178-#210).
description:
## Problem
Findings at head 41bc621c84: (1) under a heavy-run `run_config.platform_options.memory_limit` records the registry default 8GB while the adapter ran at 4GB (`benchbox/core/platform_config.py` strips only a copy); (2) memory of Docker or Apple-container processes the holder starts is counted as foreign, so a holder-caused breach can be flagged retryable; (3) `--retry-max`, `--retry-total-minutes` have no upper bound and `BENCHBOX_HEAVY_ADMIT_HOLD_SECONDS=inf` loops forever holding the lock; (4) docs/agent/heavy-work.md says exactly 4GB is treated as the default, that the last Error 79 is returned (an admission timeout returns 76) and that Spark's ceiling is 60% of host memory (it is 60% of the budget); (5) no test drives a real Guard retry flag through `_run_attempt`; (6) `spark_config` can set `spark.driver.memory` without the explicit-cap check; (7) the attribution block logs 120 characters of other processes' command lines unredacted; (8) the body claims preflight passed on the final tree using a stale receipt.

## Change
Fix each finding with a test that fails before the fix. Apply the owner's two decisions from heavy-guard-4331-owner-decisions-20261120.

## Decision gates
Does not start until the owner decisions item is done. Bounds for retry count, retry minutes and hold seconds are shown to the owner before commit. If the owner chose to close the pull request, drop this item with that reason.

## Verification rubric
Pass: one result file reports one memory limit under a heavy-run (test); a holder-started container breach is not retryable (test); out-of-range retry and hold values are refused (tests); the three doc statements match code; a test drives Guard retry through `_run_attempt`; command lines in attribution output are redacted (test); the body cites a receipt for the head tree.

## Guardrails
- Any limit, default, threshold or label text is shown to the owner before it is committed.
- The implementer never resolves review threads on its own pull request; the reviewer or the owner does.
- No polling loop around `make pr-arm`, no `--no-verify`, and no stand-in review unless the owner names the PR and head unprompted.
- Heavy work runs only through `make heavy-run` or a lock-taking entry point.
- Status reports state only what merged and what was verified, with the evidence.
